procedure: At onboarding and material change, reconcile procurement, development and deployed-service inventories to AI systems and analytical methods. Record purpose, lifecycle role, owner, version, data/model dependencies, affected groups, permitted uses and retirement state. Investigate unregistered systems before authorizing use.
reviewer_role_description: Qualified reviewer independent of preparation and operation
test_procedure: Trace independently selected deployments and supplier purchases into the register, then trace registered systems back to exact versions and dependency records. Investigate omissions and stale lifecycle states.

proposed_system_of_record: Impact assessment and independent validation register
procedure: Before high-consequence use and material change, assess impacts on individuals, groups and society, foreseeable misuse and uncertainty; link impacts to risk treatment. Define acceptance criteria for the intended use before testing. Independently challenge data, performance, limitations and proposed safeguards. Record unresolved issues and release restrictions; schedule reassessment from risk and change triggers.
reviewer_role_description: Qualified reviewer independent of preparation and operation
test_procedure: Reperform selected acceptance measures against the exact system/data versions. Trace identified impacts and failed measures into treatment or release restrictions; check independence and whether material changes triggered reassessment.

procedure: For each material change, version datasets, external models, prompts and tools; identify origin, restrictions, quality criteria and preparation steps. Review rights and security before use. Separate training and evaluation data and investigate leakage or contamination. Bind approved dependencies to the released system version.
reviewer_role_description: Qualified reviewer independent of preparation and operation
test_procedure: Trace a released version to immutable dependencies, applicable rights decisions and preparation records. Challenge missing provenance and cross-partition contamination; verify rejected inputs were excluded.

procedure: Define measures for performance, drift, harmful outcomes, overrides and feedback from the use-case risk assessment. Monitor at the approved cadence; triage threshold breaches, supplier changes and user reports. Apply stop or restriction conditions, investigate and independently validate corrective changes while retaining failed history.
reviewer_role_description: Qualified reviewer independent of preparation and operation
test_procedure: Reconcile production versions and operating periods to monitoring records. Reperform a breach classification and trace alerts, overrides and adverse feedback through escalation and validated correction.

proposed_system_of_record: AI decision authority and workflow register
procedure: At design and review, identify decisions supported or executed by AI, authorized human decision makers, prohibited uses, override rights and stop conditions. Implement workflow permissions and escalation. Train assigned operators and review bypass attempts and overrides after change.
reviewer_role_description: Qualified reviewer independent of preparation and operation
test_procedure: Attempt a prohibited or unauthorized decision in an approved test environment; confirm the block or human approval gate. Trace overrides to authorized decisions and check that operators can stop the workflow.

procedure: Maintain a risk-based programme covering the selected management systems, services and sites. Define criteria, scope, methods and independence before each engagement. Provide access and direct escalation, retain tested populations and findings, report results to accountable management, and verify corrective actions without substituting owner certification for audit work.
reviewer_role_description: Qualified reviewer independent of preparation and operation
test_procedure: Reconcile planned engagements to completed work or authorized deferrals; inspect scope exclusions, reviewer conflicts, evidence access and reporting. Trace findings to independent closure testing.

procedure: Monthly, reconcile discovered assets and software versions to vendor support and patch status. Assign remediation from approved risk targets; schedule testing, deployment and recovery. Verify installed versions after change. Escalate overdue or unsupported assets and time-limit any authorized exception.
reviewer_role_description: Qualified reviewer independent of preparation and operation
test_procedure: Select assets from discovery, including unsupported systems; reproduce support and patch status and aging. Trace due remediation to verified versions or a valid bounded exception, preserving overdue failures.

procedure: Continuously reconcile credential, key and certificate metadata to named custody and approved storage. Monitor expiry and rotation; restrict retrieval and audit access. Revoke on compromise or departure and validate dependent-service recovery after rotation. Preserve evidence without copying secret values.
reviewer_role_description: Qualified reviewer independent of preparation and operation
test_procedure: Select inventory and discovered credentials in both directions; inspect custody and expiry. In an approved test environment, verify rotation failure handling, revocation and dependent-service recovery without extracting secrets.

procedure: Before training, sharing or reuse, identify origin, controller/licensor, permitted purposes, restrictions, expiry and downstream terms. Compare the intended use and recipients with the governing rights; obtain competent review of uncertainty. Block unapproved use and reassess material purpose or source changes.
reviewer_role_description: Qualified reviewer independent of preparation and operation
test_procedure: Trace selected data uses to the exact agreement/version and approved purpose; check recipient and retention restrictions. Verify expired or rejected permissions prevent the proposed reuse.

procedure: Provide accessible reporting channels for workforce and AI-related concerns. Independently triage conflicts, urgency and potential retaliation; restrict access and preserve evidence. Assign investigators, document findings and remedies, communicate appropriately and monitor retaliation or repeat issues after closure.
reviewer_role_description: Qualified reviewer independent of preparation and operation
test_procedure: Test channel accessibility without exposing real complainants. Inspect authorized samples for independent triage, access controls, disposition and follow-up; reconcile unresolved reports to escalation.

procedure: For every material transformation, version source/target definitions and executable logic; review changes separately from authorship. Test reconciliations, invalid inputs, edge cases and data lineage before release. Bind approved logic to executed runs and retain errors and rollback records.
reviewer_role_description: Qualified reviewer independent of preparation and operation
test_procedure: Reperform a selected transformation from pinned inputs and code; reconcile outputs and rejected records. Verify deployed logic matches the reviewed version and unauthorized changes are detected.

procedure: Schedule board/committee oversight and management-system reviews with accountable participants and required information packages. For each selected management system, prepare changes in context, objectives, performance, audit results, incidents, treatment and resource needs. Track missing inputs and deferred reviews. Identify management review separately from routine board attendance.
reviewer_role_description: Qualified reviewer independent of preparation and operation
test_procedure: Reconcile scheduled reviews to records and verify required inputs were available and considered. Inspect a deferred review and a significant performance issue for escalation and follow-up.

procedure: At each governing or management-review meeting, record decisions, rationale, responsible parties, resources and due dates. Track improvements and changes to the management system alongside material board actions. Validate completion against evidence and escalate overdue commitments; preserve superseded decisions.
reviewer_role_description: Qualified reviewer independent of preparation and operation
test_procedure: Trace selected review outputs and board decisions to accountable actions and evidence of completion. Reconcile overdue items and verify closure did not erase unresolved commitments.

procedure: Continuously monitor availability, latency, errors, backlog and dependencies; review trends weekly against approved service and recovery needs. Include peak demand and recovery-site capacity. Forecast exhaustion, assign capacity action and validate improvements or escalate missed thresholds.
reviewer_role_description: Qualified reviewer independent of preparation and operation
test_procedure: Reconcile critical services and dependencies to monitored measures. Reperform a peak/recovery-capacity calculation and trace breaches to effective action, including missing monitoring periods.

procedure: Inventory critical recurring manual activities; document prerequisites, authority, ordered steps, safety checks, records, failure handling and recovery. Review annually and after material change. Have a competent alternate execute a controlled walkthrough and resolve ambiguous or unperformable steps.
reviewer_role_description: Qualified reviewer independent of preparation and operation
test_procedure: Reconcile recurring activities to current instructions; observe a selected alternate-operator walkthrough and a failure path. Verify changes reached operators and obsolete versions are withdrawn.

procedure: Before engagement, approve the requisition, role, manager and terms; include confidentiality, security and appropriate AI-use responsibilities. Obtain acknowledgment before granting relevant access. Reconcile contractor and employee onboarding to the approved engagement and required training.
reviewer_role_description: Qualified reviewer independent of preparation and operation
test_procedure: Select starters independently from payroll/vendor and identity populations. Verify approved terms, acknowledgment and access prerequisites preceded use; investigate unrecorded contractors.

procedure: Record role, manager, location and status changes promptly; send dated events to access, asset and responsibility owners. On transfer or exit, reconcile permissions and returned assets, transfer duties and communicate continuing obligations. Escalate missing acknowledgments and unfinished dependent actions.
reviewer_role_description: Qualified reviewer independent of preparation and operation
test_procedure: Reconcile selected HR changes to identity and asset populations; inspect completion timestamps, unresolved assets and residual access. Verify successor responsibilities and continuing obligations are recorded.

procedure: Semiannually, identify critical skills, workload, vacancies and single-person dependencies for service and management-system duties. Assess competence against assigned work, define deputies and training, test handover coverage and escalate unresolved capacity risks.
reviewer_role_description: Qualified reviewer independent of preparation and operation
test_procedure: Trace critical duties to competent primary and alternate coverage; inspect evidence that training and handovers address identified deficiencies. Investigate duties assigned to unavailable or unqualified personnel.

procedure: At contract and service change, record approved commitments, intended use, limitations and responsibility splits. Assign delivery ownership and communicate audience-appropriate operating information, support and reporting routes. Review nonstandard promises before acceptance and reconcile them to deliverable capability.
reviewer_role_description: Qualified reviewer independent of preparation and operation
test_procedure: Trace selected agreements and published product information to approved commitments and actual delivery owners. Investigate unsupported promises or omitted use limitations.

procedure: Before material change, assess affected users, AI purposes and dependencies, limitations and contractual notice duties. Approve the change and communication plan; issue accurate notices to affected parties and retain delivery evidence. Reassess significant unplanned changes and failures.
reviewer_role_description: Qualified reviewer independent of preparation and operation
test_procedure: Select releases from deployment records; check affected-customer analysis, required notice timing and recipient completeness. Inspect changes affecting AI limitations or responsibility splits.

procedure: Provide external reporting routes for service problems and AI adverse impacts. Triage severity, affected users and escalation duties; link repeat issues to engineering and risk/impact reassessment. Communicate appropriate responses and verify corrective changes before closure.
reviewer_role_description: Qualified reviewer independent of preparation and operation
test_procedure: Reconcile support channels to cases; inspect high-impact and repeated reports for timely escalation and risk linkage. Trace closure to validated changes and retained failure history.

procedure: Continuously ingest findings and reconcile affected assets; prioritize using approved exposure and severity criteria. Track due dates, fix ownership and mitigation; review aging monthly. Independently verify remediation and escalate overdue exposure or expiring risk acceptance without resetting the original discovery date.
reviewer_role_description: Qualified reviewer independent of preparation and operation
test_procedure: Recompute ages and targets from original findings; reperform verification on selected fixes. Inspect overdue and accepted exposure for authority, compensating measures and expiry, including reopened findings.
